item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a reliable 2024 source showing Khamenei or his system actually dismantling bonyad/IRGC business privileges, prosecuting top-level insider corruption, or opening captured sectors to fair competition. The available evidence is overwhelmingly negative, and any positive signal was absent or too weak to count.","evidence":[{"title":"Iran's Revolutionary Guards extend control over Tehran's oil exports, sources say","publisher":"Reuters / Investing.com","date":"2024-12-18","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/commodities-news/irans-revolutionary-guards-extend-control-over-tehran's-oil-exports-sources-say-3778558","summary":"Reuters reported that the IRGC had tightened its grip on oil exports, controlled up to half of the country’s oil exports, and used shadow fleets and front companies. That is strong evidence of politically connected monopoly power and capture, not resistance to it.","question_ids":["5B.5","5B.4","5B.3"]},{"title":"Iran: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/iran/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Freedom House says corruption remains endemic, while the IRGC and bonyads are above scrutiny in practice. It also says these actors have broad economic power and weak accountability, which directly contradicts any claim that Khamenei was restraining corruption or connected privilege.","question_ids":["5B.5","5B.4","4B.5"]},{"title":"Irans presidential election dominated by Khamenei loyalists","publisher":"Reuters / Investing.com","date":"2024-06-25","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/irans-presidential-election-dominated-by-khamenei-loyalists-3494879","summary":"Reuters said Khamenei ensured hardline candidates dominated the contest, his adviser wanted a president whose views did not conflict with the supreme leader, and Khamenei controls the bulk of financial resources. This points to loyalty-first political-economic control, not a cleanup of favoritism or privilege.","question_ids":["5B.5","5B.2","4B.2"]},{"title":"Khamenei protege, sole moderate neck and neck in Iran presidential race","publisher":"Reuters / Investing.com","date":"2024-06-27","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iran-holds-presidential-vote-with-limited-choices-3500514","summary":"Reuters described a tightly controlled race shaped by economic hardship and political restriction, with candidates pledging to revive the economy but not offering concrete plans. That is consistent with a system managing loyalty and rents rather than breaking up capture or creating fair competition.","question_ids":["5B.5","5B.4","5B.1"]}]}
